The Five Plates

I Frontispiece cover / landing
  • Diagonal red 『示例 — 非用户标本』 watermark on the demo plate
  • Bordered 『☞ 开卷』 CTA button under the caption — pulse
  • Footer 『档案室』 demoted (smaller, italic, ink-fade color)
  • Plate is the primary tap target — pointerdown enters picker
  • Inner ink-bleed vignette replaces the floating drop shadow
II Picker specimen + species
  • Empty specimen slot is now a dashed-border tap target
  • 『轻触上传』 / 『tap to upload』 italic hint inside the slot
  • Disabled footer CTA explains what's missing — 『请先提交肖像』 or 『请先选一种生物』
  • Persistent error bar with ✶ icon at the top on gen failure
III Processing ≈ 60-second wait
  • Faux-progress bar — sepia ink seeping right, asymptotes at 95%, snaps to 100% on settle
  • 『elapsed 02″ · est. total ~60″』 counter row under the bar
  • 『中止雕版』 / 『Abandon the engraving』 cancel link at the bottom
  • Source thumb fallback silhouette so the slot is never empty
  • Cancel cleanly throws CancelledError, bounces back to picker
IV Result reveal + caption
  • Removed duplicate 『学会判定此对象属于』 subhead — title block alone now
  • 『题字并分享』 / 『Inscribe & share』 button with quill ✎ icon
  • Share label flips to 『已复制 — 可粘贴到任意处』 after copy
  • Same plate-style frame, no modern drop shadow
V Wall community archive
  • Empty state is now a tappable button — dashed-circle ghost plate + invitation
  • 『还没有人收录』 + red seal-color 『— 再分类一次 →』 hint, soft pulse
  • List/Grid toggle bumped 26px → 32×30 with pill background + active state
  • Scope tabs (我的图版 / 全部图版) lifted to parent — survives detail round-trip
